entities.summary: Air Philippines Flight 541 was a scheduled domestic flight operated by Air Philippines from Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Metro Manila to Francisco Bangoy International Airport in Davao City. On April 19, 2000, the Boeing 737-2H4 crashed south of Davao City while on approach to the airport, killing all 124 passengers and 7 crew members. The aircraft descended below the normal altitude for the glide slope, reaching 1,400 ft from the ground, at 500 ft, the aircraft struck a coconut tree, causing it to break up and catch fire.
